NOTIFICATION UNDER SECTION 16 SUB SECTIONS (2D) OF THE COAST CONSERVATION AND
COASTAL RESOURCE MANAGEMENT ACT, No. 57 OF 1981
Proposed 140 Units of Residential Apartment Project, No. 145, Colombo Road, Galle
ENVIRONMENTAL IMPACT ASSESSMENT REPORT

IT is hereby notified that the Report of Environmental Impacts Assessment study on proposed 140 Units of ResidentialApartment Project at No. 145, Colombo Road, Galle, submitted by the Fairway Holdings Pvt. Ltd, No. 100, Buthgamuwa,Rajagiriya as required by the Section 16(1) of the Coast Conservation and Coastal Resource Management Act, No. 57 of 1981as amended by the Act, No. 64 of 1988 and No. 49 of 2011 will be available for inspection by the public at the followinginstitutions from 8.30 a. m. to 4.15 p. m. for a period of 30 days from 27.09.2018. (Except weekends and public holidays)
In addition this report with 03 languages can be used in the official web site (www.coastal.gov.lk) of the Departmentof Coast Conservation & Coastal Resource Management.

(1)Ministry of Mahaweli Development & Environment, No. 500, T. B. Jayah Mawatha, Colombo 10.(2)Coast Conservation & Coastal Resource Management Department, New Secretariat Building, 4th Floor,Maligawatte, Colombo 10.(3)Central Environmental Authority, No. 104, “Parisara Piyasa”, Denzil Kobbekaduwa Mawatha, Battaramulla.(4)Urban Development Authority, No. 6th & 7th Floors, “Sethsiripaya”, Battaramulla.(5)District Secretariat, Galle.(6)Divisional Secretariat, Galle (Town & Gravets).(7)Municipal Council, Galle.(8)District Fisheries Office, Department of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources, Galle.(9)Regional Office, Coast Conservation and Coastal Resource Management Department, Peelagoda, Unawatuna.

Any member of the public may within 30 days from 27.09.2018 submit their comments in writing on the above EnvironmentalImpact Assesstment Report to the Director General, Coast Conservation & Coastal Resource Management Department.
B. K. PRABATH CHANDRAKEERTHI,
Director General,Coast Conservation & Coastal Resource Management.
Coast Conservation & Coastal Resource Management Department,New Secretariat, 4th Floor, Maligawatta, Colombo 10.
